exceptions.rationale: CP949 to UTF-8 with //IGNORE. Debian marks this glibc iconv converter over-read no-dsa (minor issue) for trixie and lists no fixed version. Exploitation needs attacker-controlled input and charset passed to iconv. The gateway is a Rust binary that never calls iconv_open or iconv, and no Rust or bundled C dependency in Cargo.lock uses iconv. Approved by the repository owner on 2026-11-25 for 30 days; re-approved on 2026-11-26 for libc6 2.41-12+deb13u5, which fixes other glibc CVEs but not this one, without extending the expiry. Re-review on expiry or on any base-image change.
